meta.title: DM Artefact Meta-Metamodel
meta.subtitle: The typed links between the artefact models: how a business glossary term flows through the conceptual and logical data models to the dictionary, business rules and transformations, and how data quality ties to the critical data elements it measures.

layers.name: Business / semantic
layers.desc: Shared meaning: glossary terms, business domains and the reference values data is drawn from.

layers.name: Conceptual model
layers.desc: The business things and how they relate, independent of technology.

layers.name: Logical model
layers.desc: Entities and their attributes, structured but not yet physical.

layers.name: Data element / physical
layers.desc: The dictionary fields, the datasets they sit in, and the critical ones.

layers.name: Rules and transformation
layers.desc: Business rules, the transformations that implement them, and the quality rules that test them.

layers.name: Governance
layers.desc: Classification, stewardship roles and provenance that sit across every artefact.

artefacts.name: Business glossary term
artefacts.desc: An agreed business term with a definition, synonyms and relationships.

artefacts.name: Business domain
artefacts.desc: A business area that groups datasets and terms.

artefacts.name: Reference / code list
artefacts.desc: Controlled values and code lists that make data interpretable and joinable. Ties to M8.

artefacts.name: Conceptual entity
artefacts.desc: A business thing in the conceptual data model.

artefacts.name: Logical entity / attribute
artefacts.desc: An entity and its attributes in the logical data model.

artefacts.name: Data element
artefacts.desc: A field in the data dictionary: datatype, format, allowed values, classification, PII.

artefacts.name: Critical data element
artefacts.desc: A data element the business depends on, so quality is measured against it.

artefacts.name: Dataset
artefacts.desc: A nominated dataset, catalogued with its metadata.

artefacts.name: Business rule
artefacts.desc: A rule that governs allowed values, derivations or constraints on a data element. No dedicated viewer yet.

artefacts.name: Transformation
artefacts.desc: A step that derives or moves data, implementing a business rule.

artefacts.name: Data quality rule
artefacts.desc: A test and threshold that measures fitness of a critical data element.

artefacts.name: Classification / sensitivity
artefacts.desc: The sensitivity label and CIA handling of a data element. Ties to M5.

artefacts.name: Role (RACI)
artefacts.desc: The accountable and responsible roles that steward each artefact.

artefacts.name: Provenance / lineage
artefacts.desc: Who produced the data, from what and when, and the flow between datasets.
